Families have the opportunity to socialize while children develop new skills in an early learning environment. This program is offered in partnership with the Malvern Family Resource Centre (MFRC) . This is a drop-in program. No registration required.

events.title: Baby Time
events.description: Bouncing and tickling rhymes, stories, and songs for babies from birth to 18 months with their parents or caregivers.  Drop-in, no registration is required. Space is limited.

events.title: Family Time
events.description: Join us for rhymes, songs and stories for children from 0-5, with their parents or caregivers. A fun activity, game or craft to follow. Children, parents and caregivers are invited to Stay and Play.

events.title: EarlyON Music and Movement

events.title: 40th Anniversary of Franklin in the Dark
events.description: First published in 1986, join us in celebrating 40 years of the beloved Canadian turtle, Franklin. Discover the series’ original drafts by author Paulette Bourgeois and illustrator Brenda Clark, alongside other terrific turtle tales! Visit the Osborne Collection to experience our exhibit.

events.title: Ontario Trees: Scavenger Hunt!
events.description: Please join us for a special edition Ontario Trees Scavenger Hunt! In celebration of the Kids Vote Weekend , Fort York Branch invites you to search high and low, far and wide for various drawings of leaves that represent our local Ontario trees!

events.title: Month long Scavenger Hunt: Halloween!
events.description: Jones Branch would like to invite you to find all 10 Halloween themed posters hidden around the library! Ask staff for a sheet to begin. Once completed, we will stamp it with a leaf stamp. For children of all ages and their caregivers. Drop-in.

events.title: Spooky Scavenger Hunt
events.description: Trick or treat!  Stop by the library to find spooky images hidden around the children's area. Find them all and win a fun prize! This program is intended for children aged 4 to 12 years .

events.title: Spooky Scavenger Hunt
events.description: Embrace the spooky season at St. James Town by partaking in a scavenger hunt! Just ask staff at the desk for a copy. Happy looking!

events.description: The Artists in the Library series comes to Evelyn Gregory Library this Fall!  Led by professional illustrators Hilary Leung and Joseph Bonsu, children will explore the art of comics and build a portfolio of work culminating in a polished long-form comic. events.title: STEM Club
events.description: Join us at the library for a fun hour of stem related activities. Come out to build, create and code with Snap Circuits, Dash and Dot, Scratch Coding, LEGO, Magnetic Tiles and more! The club is intended for children aged 6 to 12 years. Due to the limited number of robots, participants may be asked to share with other participants. Drop-in. No registration is required.

events.title: Saturday Chess Club
events.description: Join us on the 2nd floor every Saturday for a few games of chess in a welcoming environment. All ages and all levels are welcome. Children must be accompanied by a parent or guardian to participate. Any unsupervised individuals under 18 will not be able to participate in the program. Please note: There is no chess club on Sat Nov 21 for our Big Fall Book Sale This is a drop-in program.

events.title: Robotics Workshops for Youth
events.description: Join Upper Toronto Community Robotics for accessible, hands-on robotics and engineering workshops for youth! These programs will help you build foundational skills in engineering design, safety, CAD software, 3D modeling, and introductory robotics coding. This program is for youth in grades 6-12. It is highly recommended to attend each session to build on your learning. Please register online.

events.title: STEAM Lab
events.description: Join us for our weekly STEAM Lab (Ages 6-12) , where kids can explore science, technology, engineering, art, and math through fun, hands-on activities. From building simple robots and experimenting with Snap Circuits to creative design challenges and more, there’s always something new to discover. Activities change each week, so there’s always something new to explore!

events.title: Sunday Lego Club
events.description: Join us each Sunday (barring scheduled closures) to build LEGO structures and have fun at the Forest Hill library! For children under 12 years and their families. Please ensure young children are accompanied by an adult.
